Markets.title: Warren Buffett is passing the baton: 5 investment mantras the next generation can carry forward
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett has stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman, with Howard Buffett taking the role while Greg Abel remains CEO. The transition highlights Buffett's six-decade investment philosophy focused on valuation discipline, patience, competence, emotional control, and long-term compounding.

Markets.title: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields set for weekly decline as ECB hike bets ease
Markets.summary: Eurozone bond yields are heading toward their first weekly decline since early August as investors reduce expectations for further European Central Bank rate hikes. Meanwhile, US Treasury yields have stabilized after the 10-year yield briefly surpassed 5% earlier in the week.

Markets.title: Market wrap:  Adani Ports, Adani Ports SEZ, TCS, Tata Motors PV top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities ended higher on September 18, driven by softer crude prices and supportive Asian cues. Adani Ports led the Nifty gainers with a 4.94% increase as midcaps and smallcaps advanced over 1%.

Markets.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Can SIFs become the bridge between mutual funds & alternative investments?
Markets.summary: Radhika Gupta will discuss specialized investment funds (SIFs) at the ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0. The session will explore how SIFs can serve as a regulated bridge between traditional mutual funds and alternative investments.

Markets.title: Adani stocks soar up to 12% after Jefferies sees up to 53% upside in Adani Energy and others

Markets.title: Rupee logs weekly decline; traders expect losses to be capped near 96 against USD
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee fell this week due to expectations of rising global interest rates and ongoing Middle East tensions. However, analysts expect central bank intervention to limit further losses near 96 per dollar.

Geo-Political.summary: At least 16 people were killed when an explosives-laden vehicle rammed into a mosque in Pakistan during Friday prayers. A senior police official confirmed the attack on the mosque building.

Geo-Political.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
Geo-Political.summary: Scientists have identified a spotted wildcat in Bolivia as a completely new species. Currently, there is only one known living member of this newly discovered species.

Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada are aiming to finalize a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement by the end of 2026. This move is intended to strengthen their economic ties after a period of strained bilateral relations.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's raises India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% on Middle East resilience, but risks remain
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7%, citing resilience despite Middle East challenges. However, the agency warned that high energy and El Niño-related food prices continue to threaten inflation, consumption, and growth.

Data & Insights.summary: The central government is hosting a conference for state finance ministers on October 7 to discuss financing India's path toward Viksit Bharat. This meeting precedes the GST Council meeting and the start of pre-budget consultations for the 2027-28 Union Budget on October 12.

Data & Insights.summary: Since taking office in May 2014, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has implemented major economic reforms, including demonetisation, GST, and the PLI scheme. Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea warns that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs and reduce traditional salaried employment in India. This shift will fundamentally alter how people earn and invest, driving a major transition toward gig work.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: In July, India purchased $15.2 billion in US Treasuries, marking its highest holdings in 10 months. This record surge was driven by large capital inflows from the central bank's special facilities designed to attract overseas funds.

India.summary: Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari met with Trinamool candidate Sanchita Pradhan Dey on Thursday. Mamata Banerjee has lost her party's symbol, name, and now her Nandigram candidate.

India.title: Assam Man Beheaded, Body Buried, Severed Head Put In Plastic Bag
India.summary: Anil Rajgarh from Assam was reported missing on September 12 after disappearing. Police later discovered his beheaded and buried body, with his severed head placed in a plastic bag.

General.title: Council staff refused anonymity for Sara Sharif inquest
General.summary: A coroner has denied anonymity to three council workers involved in the Sara Sharif case. Media organizations, including the BBC, successfully opposed the application to keep their identities secret.

General.title: Brewdog's unpaid workers to receive nothing after takeover deal
General.summary: Administrators revealed that Brewdog owes about £489,000 in unpaid staff wages and holiday pay, alongside £2.4 million in unpaid VAT to HMRC. As a result of the takeover deal, these unpaid workers will receive nothing.
